name: Jaipur International Airport

slots.v: general aviation operators need a written slot confirmation from the airport operations control centre (AOCC) before any flight
slots.quote: No Operator shall operate to or from JIA without first obtaining written Slot confirmation from AOCC.

ppr.v: landing and departure permission from the airport operator, slots requested at least 24 hours before; passenger name list to the GA team at least 24 hours before; ad hoc landings depend on parking and resources; approval at the operator's discretion
ppr.quote: to obtain arrival or departure slots, at least 24hrs prior to operation

handling.v: ground handling only by agencies authorised and appointed by the airport operator (none named)
handling.quote: Ground Handling services shall be exclusively provided by authorised ground handling agencies appointed by JIAL

catering.v: flight catering only through agencies approved by the airport operator
